meta.name_en: low-income and middle-low- income households_ DISABLE
meta.data_description_zh:
資料為 101 年 7 月至 104 年 12 月各月及 105 年至 114 年之列冊低收入戶及
中低收入戶之名冊。
meta.notes_zh:
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。 個人歸戶及個人資料比對的鍵值：ID。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Welfare11_低收入戶及中低收入戶資料庫
meta.data_description_en: Data for July 2011 to December 2014 and lists of registered low-income households and mid-low income households from 2015 to 2024.
meta.notes_en: The center's database has been de-identified, removing personally identifiable information such as names and addresses. Sensitive fields like ID numbers, facility codes, insured unit codes, unified numbers, dates of birth, medical visit dates, admission dates, etc., have been masked. The data can only be used within a dedicated operational area set up by the department and statistical results must be reviewed before being carried out to ensure that the data cannot be traced back to specific individuals. The key value for individual identification and personal data matching: ID.

meta.data_description_en: Data for July 2011 to December 2014 and lists of registered low-income households and mid-low income households from 2015 to 2024.
meta.notes_en: ※This database has been de-identified and direct identifying fields such as name and address have been deleted. Primary key with individual account and personal information matching value: ID.
